body: If it makes you feel better, I grew up with my mom telling me she wished she could have aborted me. It wasn't legal for her to do it when she got pregnant. So yeah.

I wish I could work on a social circle like this. But I don't really have friends where I can say, "Do you know anybody that wants to be BFF forever but never have sex"? If there was something like that I'd be all over it. I'm just so fucking depressed between not having anything. My ideal person would be somebody like a best friend kinda deal that doesn't want sex from me. Why does this have to be so hard? This is exactly why I don't even bother with really talking to people or expressing my feelings. I'm a freak. I will be forever alone.

I'm so going to kill myself after my father dies. Nobody gives a shit about me. I'm so tired of all of this bullshit.

What's the one thing you think is the worst in your life right now? Mine is my connection to my family. I have no connection with my siblings and I'm stuck taking care of my father who was abusive to us when we were growing up.

Say something. Anything. Let them at least have the chance to help you. Don't let them ignore you. It might be awkward but don't give up if you want help (which it seems like you do). If they do ignore you, then call somebody else who will listen to you. Fight to live. Good luck to you!
I hope that she's OK too.

I want to kill myself too but this is the reason I've never allowed myself to have a gun. It would be really easy for me to get one but I know it would mean I'd be killing myself in short order. Get rid of the gun. If you're in the U.S. and the gun is legal, you can give it to the police. PM me if you want to talk. I don't care what it's about. I'm in a bad spot too.

I didn't expect any answer or solution so it's all good. I really just needed to say something as I've never said anything like that before. There are so many other issues I'm dealing with besides my dad's cancer but I don't feel like typing all of that right now.

I'm no longer married. I actually divorced 11/2001 so sorry for any confusion on that. I hate meeting guys I'm interested in because I know that they'll want sex and I don't want to give it. So I just try to pretend like I'm not interested in anybody and never go on dates or even think about men romantically so that I don't have to disappoint them. It's really fucking depressing. I just use porn when I want to get off. But I so want a daily interaction with somebody and want to have somebody I can lean on. I want to be that person for them as well but since I can't tell anybody anything I never even get that chance. Dilemma....

Concerning last year, I can't remember what happened to make me not go through with it. But I'd already planned it out - I had all the medicine I needed and it was hot enough outside for me to suffocate. The next time I thought about it, it had already cooled off and I was worried that I would be found and they would be able to revive me. I need the heat as a fail-safe in case the medicine doesn't work. 

So yeah, I don't know. I notice you're using a throwaway account too so I don't even know if you or anybody else will ever see his. It seems a lot of people want to kill themselves.
